name: Ikeda (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ikeda town emblem in white: an outlined triangle with rounded corners enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ikeda, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 June 1968.

features.role: Ikeda town emblem — an outlined triangle with rounded corners enclosing a stylised character
